title: Addendum to o3 and o4-mini system card: Codex
summary: Codex is a cloud-based coding agent. Codex is powered by codex-1, a version of OpenAI o3 optimized for software engineering. codex-1 was trained using reinforcement learning on real-world coding tasks in a variety of environments to generate code that closely mirrors human style and PR preferences, adheres precisely to instructions, and iteratively runs tests until passing results are achieved.
body: Codex is a cloud-based coding agent. Codex is powered by codex-1, a version of OpenAI o3 optimized for software engineering. codex-1 was trained using reinforcement learning on real-world coding tasks in a variety of environments to generate code that closely mirrors human style and PR preferences, adheres precisely to instructions, and iteratively runs tests until passing results are achieved.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了Codex的系统卡补充说明，Codex是一款基于o3模型优化而成的云端编程智能体。该模型通过在真实编程任务中进行强化学习训练，能够生成符合人类编码风格和PR偏好的代码，并具备自动运行测试直至通过的能力。Codex旨在通过迭代式测试与指令遵循，提升软件工程的自动化水平，是AI辅助编程领域的重要进展。

aiReview.reasonZh: Codex作为专门针对软件工程优化的智能体，代表了AI在代码生成与自动化测试领域的最新进展。

glossary.explanationZh: 智能体，指能够自主执行任务、进行决策并与环境交互的AI系统。
强化学习，一种通过奖励机制训练模型以实现特定目标的机器学习方法。
Pull Request，代码协作中用于提交修改请求的流程。
软件工程，涉及软件开发全生命周期的系统化方法。
